note: Statement-deletion sweep over the guards S10c.1-S10c.5 added. Each row asks: if this line vanished, would ANY test notice? Two classes matter here. (1) Contract guards whose absence restores a SILENT failure -- a deploy gate that passes while validating nothing, an exit code that reports success on rejected code. (2) Security-posture guards whose absence is invisible to every functional test, because a 0644 file behaves exactly like a 0600 one until someone else reads it. gremlins mutates expressions and ships no statement-deletion operator, so these are mutations it cannot produce.
